items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1996-08-23
items.q: Mary Lou Williams, she did a special show, I think, at the Coliseum Arena with the backing of Dookie Chase's band.

ctx.x: We're back with Tex Stevens. We stopped the tape for a little while to adjust a couple of things. One of the most Yeah, Tex, why don't you go ahead?

Well, Ted, you know, we left off talking about moving into a new era into the 70s, 80s, before we got into the 90s, getting a little backdrop on history. A lot of things that we discovered on the tapes that we have been doing. Let's backdrop a little bit. Let's go back to the 40s, back in 1942, when Andy Kirk and his clouds of joy came here with Big June Richmond. And then also one of the singers on the program was a guy by the name of Fay Terrell. Fay Terrell, P-H-A, that's the way he spelled it, was one of the…
I imagine you have some here.

Yep. Some of my collections, I brought them to Dr. Rayburn to put into the archives that will live forever around here. So, like I said, we have done some things that I really feel proud of that I had lived at a time in history for the growth of the city of New Orleans in the greater metropolitan area where some positive things have been done between whites and blacks collectively, you know, because we...
